name: Input Buffer
description: Makes slightly-early clicks still count by buffering your jump input.

buffer-ms.name: Buffer Window (ms)
buffer-ms.description: How long a quick tap is kept 'held' so it can still trigger a jump or orb. 60-100 ms feels natural; higher is more forgiving.

ufo.name: Buffer in UFO
ufo.description: Only helps with orbs; UFO flaps fire on press anyway.

in-practice-only.name: Practice Mode Only
in-practice-only.description: Only buffer inputs while in practice mode.
